scope: Scene container ownership, outgoing data, active/load-state persistence and actual native/NovaPak reopen. Scene navigation/load state is editor navigation, not an independently Undoable property; authoring children retain their own history contracts.

checks.name: Scene creation captures outgoing entity data and native/export retain inactive load flags
Unloading the only loaded scene is rejected and activating an unloaded scene restores its world
SceneManager defensively owns captured data and reload returns an independent copy
Invalid loaded flags reject before draft settlement or scene mutation
Scene inheritance rejects missing self and cyclic sources without partial writes
